scope: resolved_calcium@2 combines resolved_tissue@3 mixed Kv1.5/Kir2.1 populations with cell-owned finite cytosol/ER chemistry, Cav1.2, PMCA, synthetic reversible NCX, buffered calcium and IP3. Four synthetic closed two-cell/four-patch/five-outside 2-ms cases; five potassium populations including two on one patch. Assembly controls all populations by cell owner. Numerical composition qualification, not additional biological cases.
checks: Explicit versioned mixed-law composition, nested ionic identity, checkpoint-visible integer law codes and strict model/law/species/temperature/step rejection. Old calcium layout and Kv-only rates reduce bitwise to resolved_calcium@1.

Internal potassium exchange between cytosol and ER changes Kv/Kir transport through owned free concentrations without charging plasma capacitors; independent full-state rates and energy. Blocking Kir populations freezes their transfer but not intrinsic gates.
Two batched worlds carry different per-population law arrays and must match their own complete standalone histories bitwise; changing a law is rejected as a checkpoint branch.
Previous accepted pinned BETSE isolated Kv1.5/Kir2.1 law validation is prerequisite context; this run does not claim native coupled BETSE calcium/tissue equivalence or a new parameter fit.

CPU independent references are reused in the following GPU phase only after checking passed status and exact serialized physical/execution inputs with the CPU backend; no reuse of old composition trajectories.
Reference logarithmic means checked against 90-digit Decimal arithmetic; all four calcium arms retain node current balance at small initial probes without relaxing physical tolerances
Strict identity/ownership/initial-pool declarations; conserved global chemical loss bounds require finite closed exterior; rejection of held baths and unsafe timesteps
Independent full-node field roots and scalar/Decimal ion, ER, PMCA/NCX and Cav rates on compact/padded states and evolved stages; independently differentiated whole-system free energy
Internal calcium binding, ER exchange and IP3 binding cannot charge plasma capacitors; only owned free cytosolic concentrations drive membrane and junction transport
Local/global external transport, intracellular chemical reaction/ER ledgers, conserved ionic and nonionic moieties, charge increments and three maintained ATP-source work identities

Four complete thirty-four-field trajectories against segmented adaptive DOP853; blocked/released flux histories retain evolving intrinsic gates; chemical-only events remain accepted observation boundaries
Every state-field corruption rejected; actual invalid held controls, invalid RK4 trials and unconverged field solves refuse advancement; no clipping or hidden repair
Three timesteps; exact disk/fresh-process/terminal continuation; future transport branches preserve state and evolving gates; changed integration windows
Ordinary lax.map worlds with independent clocks, partition/reordering and complete batch restart; complete ionic ensemble with explicitly identified patch voltages

Two neutral cell-owned assembly pools control all Kv1.5/Kir2.1 patch populations belonging to their cells; independently reconstructed random event histories and segmented electrical/chemical trajectories

Exact complete assembly restart, changed windows and world partition; IP3 perturbation changes calcium without changing one-way assembly random events; owned ligand, calcium and patch readouts survive aggregation. Initial and evolved reports are checked directly against cell-owned state; missing ligand or calcium sections must be rejected
One versus sixteen GPU planning preserves world definitions and identity; no remote execution claim
Complete CPU/L4 state and readout comparisons, with separate charge/current/voltage tolerances and exact discrete event state; shared schema and checkpoint regressions
GPU busy and measured SM-active, per-counter coverage, allocated phase time, resource bounds, frozen sources and durable failure/completion receipts
scope_exclusions: Finite closed exterior only. Held-bath calcium input needs an independently bounded nonconserved chemical inventory and is deferred; the earlier resolved_tissue@2/@3 models retains its qualified reservoirs
Synthetic manufactured charge backgrounds and concentrations, including exterior Ca=0.02 mM for bounded conserved-pool verification; no measured tissue dataset or biological calibration
Pinned process equations are reused; this does not establish native full BETSE tissue trajectory or screened/finite-difference field equivalence
Maintained ATP/ADP/Pi sources, not a finite metabolic reaction network; synthetic NCX and buffer kinetics
Assembly is a one-way neutral-protein channel-availability hypothesis. No biochemical feedback into assembly, protein energy, or experimentally established calcium/assembly link
Accepted-grid observations only. No interpolation guarantee, moving boundaries, water flow, deformation or growth
Dense resolved electrical closure and up to sixteen owned cells per world. Sixteen-GPU readiness concerns independent worlds; no multi-GPU execution or distributed single tissue is qualified here
GPU counters include compilation and host correctness work. No single warmed interval or utilization/throughput target is claimed

The old resolved_calcium@1 definition remains Kv1.5-only. Numerical controls, refinements, old-model reductions and assembly replay are not independent biological cases. The two-task/channel-compensation research remains parked.
